item.title: One of the most important small town papers of the industrial age closing
item.description: OIL CITY, Pennsylvania — The Derrick will be no more. Derrick Publishing Company, publisher of the Derrick and the News-Herald, announced Thursday that it will cease publication. Employees were told the decision was driven by the long-term decline in support for newspapers, along with regional losses in employment, retail activity, advertising revenue, and readership.
